title: Delta-impact forecasting and golden-shard rotation with signed manifests
creator: Asha Mehta
description:
Problem: Current golden prompt collections are large monoliths. When configs or model variants change, we run full re-evals which are slow and noisy; rotations are manual and have limited forecasting of customer impact. This ticket implements a shard-based rotation system with delta-impact forecasting and signed manifests to support automated, auditable rotations and safe rollbacks.

Goal: Provide an automated pipeline that: (1) breaks golden corpora into stable shards with provenance stamps, (2) computes a predicted quality delta for a proposed config/model change using a lightweight delta-sample simulator, (3) issues a signed rotation manifest if forecasted regressions are within tolerances, (4) runs canary evaluation on a representative shard subset, and (5) supports one-click rollback via manifest reverse-apply.

Why different: Instead of only gating on full-run evals, we use shard-level delta forecasting + manifest-driven state transitions to reduce latency between config change and actionable decision while preserving auditability and steward control.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest v2 schema defined and documented in Confluence (fields: shard_ids, steward_id, signature, previous_manifest_id, sample_hashes, expected_delta_metrics)
Rotation API endpoint implemented: POST /goldens/rotate with manifest validation and signature verification
Delta-forecasting job implemented: produces a ranked list of shards with predicted regression probability and confidence band
Canary runner wired into CI: canary job runs on 5% shard sample and produces pass/fail and actionable diff report within 30 minutes for typical corpus sizes
Audit log entries created for all manifest creates/approvals/rollbacks with steward and timestamp
RBAC enforced: only users with 'golden-steward' role can sign manifests; others can propose but not approve
Rollback path validated end-to-end via testnet run and documented playbook (including data retention and TTL semantics)
tasks: Design shard layout strategy and TTL/rotation cadence (team sync w/ PM & DS)
Prototype delta-sampler: synthetic perturbations + model-in-the-loop scoring
Implement manifest schema and signature verification middleware
Add rotation API and CLI helpers for stewards
Build canary orchestration: k8s job templates + result collector
Integrate audit events into Console (timeline + download of manifest)
Write enforcement tests and e2e regression playbook
decisions: Use content-addressed shard IDs (sha256 of sorted sample IDs) to simplify dedup and provenance
Use Ed25519 for manifest signatures and store public keys in KMS-backed steward registry
Initial canary sample size set to 5% (configurable by project) to balance speed vs signal
Delta-forecasting will use a lightweight ensemble (model proxy + heuristics) rather than full eval to keep turnaround under 30m
Rollbacks are executed by applying an inverse manifest that points to previous shard set; we will not delete rotated shards immediately (TTL 30 days)
